segments: [0.30-2.48]  Imagine an engineer inside a refinery.
[3.16-5.52]  Every day they deal with highly sensitive data.
[6.06-8.60]  Now, imagine they need to analyze the report
[8.60-10.74]  to prepare an approval ready note.
[11.24-13.88]  But using the public AI is not allowed
[13.88-16.46]  due to organization, security, and competences.
[16.84-18.62]  So they left with two options.
[19.12-22.16]  Either doing all the work manually by wasting hours.
[22.58-25.30]  Secondly, pasting all the document to a public AI
[26.74-31.22]  So the real challenge is how we can bring the modern AI
[31.22-34.62]  to the organization without sending the data outside.
